title: Work of the Almost-Wise Construction
statement: For an almost-wise input with independence order $k$, output dimension $n$, bias numerator $a$, and bias denominator $b$, the total construction work is the Vandermonde construction work plus the deterministic small-bias construction work, plus $2^B$ times the matrix-vector multiplication work per output, where $B$ is twice the field degree of the associated small-bias input.
hypotheses_covered: Bias at most one half: $2a\le b$
